# credits (registry module)

> An Effect-TS Credits service (Context.Tag + Layer) wrapping @suluk/credits (the atomic debit CAS + idempotent grant stay upstream), its Hono routes, schema re-export, and a provision fragment for the D1 tables. The hybrid pattern: own the service wiring, npm the money logic.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `creditsRoutes`
- `Credits`
- `CreditsLive`
- `creditTransaction`: The credit-ledger schema (Suluk registry: `credits`) — re-exported from `@suluk/credits`, which OWNS the table
definitions (the append-only `credit...
- `creditsProvision`
- `creditsOps`
